name: Editorial
source: A product told like a magazine spread: a strict grid, a serif and a grotesk pairing, big cropped photographs or plates, captions, rules and folios, pages turning and columns reflowing. Described from the atlas editorial and print entries; no layouts are carried.

frame_device.what: A visible grid (column rules, a folio, a running head) on a paper or cream ground, with one big image area and one big type area per spread.
frame_device.moves: Spreads turn or slide on the grid; columns reflow word by word; a pull-quote scales up out of the body text; captions and rules draw on.

ground_motion: A slow page-paper tone drift and a 1 to 2 percent camera creep across the spread; hairline rules shimmer by a pixel on beats; the grid never moves.

type.classes: A high-contrast serif for headlines and pull-quotes, a neutral grotesk for captions, folios and labels; sizes in a strict scale (display, deck, body, caption).
type.behaviour: Headlines enter by line or word with a mask reveal; captions fade in 0.2 s after their image; pull-quotes scale from the body text; everything sits on the grid.

image.treatment: Large cropped photographs or Codex plates with one consistent grade, hard rectangular crops, thin keylines; the real product UI appears as a framed figure with a caption.
image.behaviour: Images enter by mask reveal or a page turn, drift 2 percent inside their frame, and are re-cropped between beats (the same image reused 3 or more times).

transitions: page turn or slide on the grid
mask reveal wipe up from a rule
crop punch-in to a detail of the same image
rule draws across and the next spread is under it

techniques.name: Grid draw-on
techniques.what: Column rules, a folio and a running head draw on to set the page.
techniques.route: SVG lines with RasanShape.drawOn(tl, svg, {at, duration: 0.8, stagger: 0.05}); folio text fades in.

techniques.name: Headline mask reveal
techniques.what: A big serif headline rises line by line out of its baseline.
techniques.route: RasanType.maskReveal(tl, el, {at, duration: 0.6, dir: 'up', stagger: 0.1}) on RasanShape.split lines.

techniques.name: Image crop reuse
techniques.what: The same plate is re-cropped to a new detail on each beat.
techniques.route: Image in an overflow:hidden frame; scale and translate keys per beat (2.0x focus on a detail), 0.7 s power3.inOut.

techniques.name: Pull-quote scale
techniques.what: A phrase from the body copy grows into the pull-quote.
techniques.route: RasanShape.split words of the body, scale the chosen span 1 to 4 with a position tween to the quote slot, others fade to 0.15.

techniques.name: Page turn
techniques.what: The spread turns to the next on a hinge at the gutter.
techniques.route: CSS 3D rotateY 0 to -180 on a page half with perspective 2000 px over 0.8 s power2.inOut; the back face is the next spread.

techniques.name: Caption follows
techniques.what: A caption and a keyline arrive after their image, 0.2 s late.
techniques.route: Keyline drawOn then the caption opacity 0 to 1 with y 8 to 0, 0.4 s, at image end + 0.2 s.

techniques.name: Column reflow
techniques.what: Body text re-wraps from two columns to three, word by word.
techniques.route: RasanType.reorder(tl, wordSpans, {order, at, duration: 0.9, stagger: 0.01}) between two layouts measured at build.

techniques.name: Figure UI plate
techniques.what: The real product UI appears as a captioned figure inside the grid.
techniques.route: Screen plate in a keylined frame with a 'Fig. 1' caption; slides in on the grid with a 12 px rise; glow only on the one control.

techniques.name: Word choreography
techniques.what: Each word of a line enters from its own place and settles into the line with a lift; the key word last with a little more overshoot.
techniques.route: RasanShape.split(el, {by: 'words'}); words rise 16 to 40 px with a mask reveal, 0.5 s, stagger 0.07 s, key word last with back.out(1.2); grid-locked, never overshooting its column.

signature: The final spread turns to a full-bleed plate with the product name set as a single masthead line.

density.note: A new crop, turn or reveal every 1.2 to 2 s; layers at the peak: 4 to 7 (paper, grid, image, headline, caption, rule, folio).

palette.note: A brand palette replaces the accent and the ink; the cream ground and the grid stay.

do: Keep every element on the visible grid
Reuse one plate 3 or more times with new crops
Pair one serif with one grotesk
dont: Do not add glow, 3D or particle effects
Do not break the grid for effect
Do not use more than two typefaces
Do not leave a plate static for more than 1.2 s
